connect.title: Hubungi LinkedIn
connect.intro: Masuk ma mamakei akun LinkedIn na mangatur iklan nassiam. Leadrat pitah mambasa akun iklan nassiam, Lead Gen Form pakon statistik iklan, pakon mangirim konversi na i-on nassiam.
connect.need1: Sada peran bani akun iklan LinkedIn (Penonton atap lobih gijang).
connect.need2: Sada peran bani halaman perusahaan na ihubungkon (Administrator, Lead Gen Forms Manager , Content Admin , Kurator atap Analis) - LinkedIn mangindo ase mambagihon prospek.
connect.need3: Sada sungkun-sungkun nomor telepon bani Lead Gen Forms nassiam - prospek na lang marnomor telepon lang boi itambahkon.

capi.title: Conversions API
capi.intro: Patugah ma hubani LinkedIn ise humbani prospekni na gabe prospek na sasintongni. Sanggah sada prospek LinkedIn das bani status na ipilih nassiam i toruh on, Leadrat melaporhon ai hubani LinkedIn , ase laporan kampanye nassiam pataridahkon kualitas prospek pakon LinkedIn boi mandapotkon buei halak na songon prospek terbaik nassiam. Pitah ID lead LinkedIn pakon hash sada arah ni email ai do na itongos.
capi.noRules: Lang dong ope status na ipetahon.
capi.created: Konversi ibahen i LinkedIn pakon ipetahon.

activity.title: Catatan kegiatan
activity.intro: Haganup antara Leadrat pakon LinkedIn : koneksi, ganup sinkronisasi, ganup lead pakon aha na masa hujai, konversi pakon kesalahan.
